screen: Organization / HRIT — Org Setup (Organization Profile, Department Management, Department Hierarchy, Employee Directory, Role & Permissions)
screenLevelGaps: OWNERSHIP VERDICT — JOB ROLE IS NOT MASTERED IN ORGANIZATION/HRIT. It is mastered in Competency's Libraries & Taxonomy. Proof: the only CRUD write path for job roles is Api/Competency/LibraryController::storeJobrole/updateJobrole/destroyJobrole (routes/api.php:296-300), and LibraryController.php:68-86 declares that resource's table as `s_user_jobrole` with writable fields jobrole, description, department, sub_department, department_id, job_level, jobrole_category, responsibilities, salary_range, benefits, education, experience, training. Organization/HRIT contains NO job-role create/edit/delete anywhere: tbluserController only *reads* the list (`$res['jobroleList'] = userJobroleModel::where('sub_institute_id',...)` at tbluserController.php:104 and :536/:1102), and HRIT's own /jobroles-by-department (Api/HRITDashboard/JobroleApiController.php:27) also only SELECTs from `s_user_jobrole`. Org/HRIT owns only the ASSIGNMENT of a job role to a person: tbluser.allocated_standards -> s_user_jobrole.id (tbluserController.php:86). So the customer's likely suspicion that job role is duplicated between Org and Competency is WRONG at the module level — Competency is the single writer and Org is a pure consumer.

THE REAL JOB-ROLE DUPLICATION IS INSIDE THE COMPETENCY/LEGACY STACK, NOT BETWEEN MODULES. There are TWO job-role definition tables. (a) `s_jobrole` — a platform/global catalogue whose department key is a STRING column named `track` (Api/jobrolecontroller.php:30-34 `DB::table('s_jobrole')->select('jobrole')->where('track',$id)`; HRMS/departmentController.php:54,73). (b) `s_user_jobrole` — the tenant library the whole product actually joins on. libraries/jobroleLibrary1Controller.php:269-291 copies rows from s_jobrole into s_user_jobrole (`$jobData = jobroleModel::where('id',$request->jobroleId)->first()` then `userJobroleModel::insert($insertData)`), so the two drift the moment either side is edited. Route /api/department/{id}/jobroles still serves the STALE s_jobrole copy while every screen in this module reads s_user_jobrole. Two live endpoints answer 'what job roles does this department have?' with different tables.

DEPARTMENT *IS* CORRECTLY MASTERED IN ORGANIZATION/HRIT — the suspicion of duplication does not hold here. `hrms_departments` has exactly one SPA write path (HRMS/DepartmentManagementController::store/update/destroy, routes/api.php:761) and Competency/LMS/Talent/Performance all consume it read-only by id (SkillHeatmapController.php:40,146; CompetencyDashboardController.php:81,102,829; lms_course_settings.restrict_departments documented as 'JSON arrays of hrms_departments.id'). This is the one clean source-of-truth boundary in the module.

BUT THE DEPARTMENT KEY IS DUPLICATED AS A FREE-TEXT COPY ON THE JOB ROLE. s_user_jobrole carries `department` and `sub_department` as plain strings (migration 2025_06_24_072253_add_coulmns_s_user_jobrole.php:17-18) in addition to a `department_id`. Renaming a department through Department Management (DepartmentManagementController::update, which only UPDATEs hrms_departments.department) leaves every s_user_jobrole.department string pointing at the old name. Competency's role-mapping and LMS's restrict_roles then disagree with the org chart.

`s_user_jobrole.department_id` HAS NO MIGRATION IN THIS REPO. LibraryController.php:80 lists it as a writable field and CompetencyDashboardController.php:81,102 joins `jr.department_id = hd.id`, but no file under database/migrations creates that column on s_user_jobrole (only 2025_06_12_070052 create, 2025_06_24_072253 add-columns, 2026_04_07_120000 progression, 2026_04_08_120002 sequence_order). The department<->jobrole link is therefore not schema-guaranteed on a fresh install.

TWO COMPLETELY INDEPENDENT, MUTUALLY UNAWARE PERMISSION SYSTEMS SHIP IN THIS MODULE. (1) The Role & Permissions screen writes tblgroupwise_rights_g2g keyed on tbluserprofilemaster (tblmenumasterG2gController::storeGroupwiseRightsG2g:131-188) — real, tenant-scoped, transactional. (2) Organization Profile, Department Management and Department Hierarchy gate themselves on a HARD-CODED 4-role matrix compiled into the bundle: types/role.ts:26-48 MATRIX for roles 'admin'|'hr'|'dept-head'|'employee'. Nothing connects them: no screen reads can_add/can_edit/can_delete from the saved rights, and grep shows tblgroupwise_rights_g2g is consumed only by menu/sidebar code, never by an API authorization check. Every /api endpoint in this module authorizes on token+sub_institute_id alone, so the six action checkboxes an admin ticks control menu VISIBILITY only, not what the API will accept.

THE HARD-CODED ROLE MATRIX IS ALSO DEAD AT RUNTIME, WHICH SILENTLY BRICKS ORGANIZATION PROFILE. Screens are mounted by components/shell/gtg-app-shell.tsx:110 as `<ContentComponent />` with NO props. OrganizationInformation({role}: {role: Role}) (organization-information.tsx:55), DepartmentList (department-list.tsx:230) and DepartmentHierarchy (department-hierarchy.tsx:129) all require a `role` prop that is never supplied. getAccess() therefore returns undefined, so on Organization Profile `canEdit = access === 'full'` is permanently false and the Edit Information button NEVER renders for anyone — the screen is read-only in production for every user including Admin. On Department Management the same bug flips the other way: `canManage = access !== 'none'` is true for everyone, so Add/Edit/Delete Department render for all users regardless of role.

DEPARTMENT HIERARCHY IS DEAD CODE AND 100% MOCK. department-hierarchy.tsx is referenced only by components/domain/organization/index.ts:4 and app/organization/hierarchy/page.tsx (which just redirects to /module/organizational-management/org-setup/hierarchy). hooks/content-map-m1.ts:21-27 registers only Organization Profile, Department Management, Employee Directory, Role & Permissions, Compliance Library and Disciplinary Library — there is no hierarchy accessLink, so the redirect lands on ComingSoonFallback. The component itself builds its tree from `DEPARTMENTS` in lib/gtg-org-data.ts:70-83 (12 hardcoded rows) and calls no API at all. Organization Profile advertises it at organization-information.tsx:348 ('Full interactive view available under Department Hierarchy').

THE MODULE CANNOT SUPPLY 'HIERARCHY' OR 'DEPARTMENT HEAD' TO ANY DOWNSTREAM MODULE BECAUSE THE COLUMNS DO NOT EXIST. migration 2025_06_10_123051_create_hrms_departments_table.php:14-39 defines only id, department, parent_id, tasks, roles_responsibility, status, is_calculated, sub_institute_id, audit columns. There is no hod / head_user_id and no headcount. Hence department-list.tsx:183-184 hardcodes `hod: null, employees: 0` for every row. The Head column, the Employees column, the tree count badge, 'Assign HOD', 'Assign / Change HOD' and 'Change HOD' are all structurally unimplementable against today's schema.

THERE IS NO REPORTING-LINE SOURCE OF TRUTH, despite the spec naming this module as owner of it. The only manager field is tbluser.supervisor_opt — a plain `string` with no foreign key (migration 2025_04_30_083830_create_tbluser_table.php:88), written by personal-info-tab.tsx:290-298 as a bare tbluser.id string via the catch-all loop in tbluserController::updateData:330-355. Nothing reads it back into a tree: no org-chart endpoint, no manager-of / reports-to query anywhere in the module. Talent (succession, IJP approvals), Performance (review routing) and Task Management (delegation) all need this and none can get it.

ADD EMPLOYEE CREATES NOTHING. The entire 5-step 'Onboard New Employee' wizard (employee-directory-sheets.tsx:181-356) holds no form state, has no submit handler, and its final button `onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}` (line 347) merely closes the sheet. Its Department, Job Role, LOR, User Profile and Reporting Manager dropdowns are hardcoded 2-3 item literals (lines 243, 247, 251, 255, 287). Identity — the thing this module is supposed to own — can only be created through the legacy Blade path, and tbluserController::store:181 reads sub_institute_id from `session()`, which a token-authenticated SPA does not have.

THE EMPLOYEE DIRECTORY THROWS AWAY REFERENCE DATA THE SAME API CALL ALREADY RETURNED. employee-directory.tsx:107 calls /user/add_user?type=API, and tbluserController::index:103-106 returns `departments` (live hrms_departments), `jobroleList` (live s_user_jobrole), `levelOfResponsbility` and `user_profiles` alongside `data`. The component reads only `data` (line 115) and then populates its Department and Job Role filters from hardcoded 3-item arrays (lines 163-167 and 175-179: 'Engineering'/'Human Resources'/'Marketing', 'Senior Developer'/'HR Manager'/'Content Strategist'). Filtering a real tenant's directory is therefore impossible.

CROSS-TENANT LEAK RISK IN THE DIRECTORY FETCH. employee-directory.tsx:107 builds the URL with `sub_institute_id=${sub_institute_id || 1}`. tbluserController::index:72 takes that value verbatim for API-type calls. A session missing sub_institute_id silently returns tenant 1's entire employee list. Every other call in this module goes through lib/laravel-context.ts, which deliberately has no defaults ('a hardcoded sub_institute_id / token would silently point every browser at the same tenant') — this one call bypasses it.

THE DIRECTORY ALSO SHOWS ONLY THE CALLER TO NON-ADMINS. tbluserController::index:93-95 restricts to `tbluser.id = user_id` unless the profile name is literally ADMIN/SUPER ADMIN or the request carries `menu_type`. employee-directory.tsx:107 sends neither, so a Department Head or HR Manager whose profile is named anything else sees a one-row directory — and the four KPI tiles then compute over that single row.

THE COMPETENCY RATING SAVE IN THE EMPLOYEE DRAWER IS BROKEN TWO WAYS AND CAN NEVER SUCCEED. (a) services/organization/employee-profile-service.ts:101 PUTs `{ proficiency_level: level }` to /competency/employee-profiles/{id}/skills/{matrixId}, but EmployeeCompetencyProfileController::updateSkill:325-334 validates `'skill_level' => 'required|integer|min:1|max:5'` — every call returns 422. (b) The `matrixId` passed is the id of a KABA item returned by fetchJobRoleKaba, not an s_skill_matrix.id; updateSkill:336-344 looks up `s_skill_matrix WHERE id=$matrixId AND user_id=$id` and 404s. This is the ONLY write path from Org/HRIT into the competency store and it is non-functional. The failure is swallowed — competency-rating-tab.tsx:47 fires handleRate with no error surface.

THE EMPLOYEE DRAWER'S COMPETENCY DATA COMES FROM A HARDCODED THIRD-PARTY HOST, NOT FROM THIS PRODUCT'S COMPETENCY MODULE. employee-profile-service.ts:85 does `fetch(`${resolveHpApiBaseUrl()}/get-kaba?...`)` and lib/api-config.ts:42 defaults that to 'https://hp.triz.co.in'. No /get-kaba route exists in hp_erp/routes/api.php. So 'Competency Rating' for an employee is read from an external legacy service keyed on s_user_jobrole.id, while the tenant's own KASBA library (s_user_knowledge / s_user_ability / s_user_attitude / s_user_behaviour, LibraryController.php:101-165) is never consulted. This is the single clearest violation of the spec's 'no duplicated build of framework, ratings'.

THE JOBROLE-SKILL TAB CAPTURES KASBA VALIDATION JUDGEMENTS AND DISCARDS THEM. jobrole-skill-tab.tsx lines 238/247 (knowledge), 282/291 (ability), 326/335 (attitude), 370/379 (behaviour) and 191/202 (overall proficiency) are Yes/No toggles wired to `toggleValidation` / `setOverallProficiency` — pure local useState with no persistence call anywhere in the file. A manager's per-item validation of an employee against their job role's KASBA is lost on tab change.

DELETING A DEPARTMENT ORPHANS EMPLOYEES. DepartmentManagementController::destroy:233-242 soft-deletes hrms_departments (status=0, deleted_at) and its children, and touches nothing else. tbluser.department_id keeps pointing at the dead row. The directory join at tbluserController.php:85 does not filter on status, so the employee still displays the removed department, while the Department dropdown (tbluserController.php:103, `where('status',1)`) no longer offers it — the employee becomes uneditable-into-a-valid-department. Note the legacy Blade controller DOES clean up (HRMS/departmentController.php:442-443 deletes s_user_jobrole rows by department_id) but the SPA never calls it.

ORGANIZATION PROFILE WRITES A MOCK HEADCOUNT BACK INTO THE DATABASE. organization-information.tsx:51 computes `totalEmployees: Number(data.employee_count) || ORG_PROFILE.totalEmployees` (1284, from lib/gtg-org-data.ts:29) and line 159 then sends `employee_count: String(org.totalEmployees)` on save. Saving a tenant whose employee_count is null/0 persists the demo value 1284. Line 162 also hardcodes `country_code: '+91'` for every tenant on every save.

SISTER COMPANIES ARE READ-ONLY IN THE UI THOUGH THE BACKEND SUPPORTS WRITES. organizationDetailsController::store:148-194 fully handles a `sister_companies[]` array with per-row logo upload into organizationSisterDetails. services/organization/index.ts:136-143 never sends that key, and the 'Add Sister Company' button (organization-information.tsx:294-297) has no onClick. Multi-entity customers cannot register a subsidiary.

THE ADDRESS IS STORED AS ONE COMMA-JOINED STRING AND PARSED BACK BY POSITION. organization-information.tsx:150-157 joins line1,line2,city,state,postal,country with `.filter(Boolean).join(', ')`; splitAddress (lines 25-35) reads them back by index. Any empty field shifts every later field one slot left, so a blank Address Line 2 permanently corrupts City/State/Postal/Country on the next load. A comma inside a street name does the same.

SOPs, POLICIES AND RULES — the three governance tabs of the Department Details drawer — ARE ENTIRELY CLIENT-SIDE MOCKS. sops-tab.tsx:79 MOCK_SOPS, policies-tab.tsx:34/372 MOCK_POLICIES + useState, rules-tab.tsx:35/402 MOCK_RULES + useState. No fetch/apiClient/webClient/useQuery appears in any of the three files. Every add/edit/delete/upload in them is lost on close. hrms_departments has `tasks` and `roles_responsibility` columns that these tabs could have used and do not.

ROLE & PERMISSIONS IS THE ONE FULLY-WIRED SCREEN IN THIS MODULE — worth saying plainly, because it is the exception. use-role-permissions.ts + services/navigation/menu-rights.ts drive four real endpoints (routes/user.php:45-52) against tblmenumaster_g2g / tblgroupwise_rights_g2g / tbluserprofilemaster; the save is transactional and invalidates the sidebar query so the caller's own menu updates (use-role-permissions.ts:114-115). Its only gaps are the missing enforcement noted above, no edit/delete/deactivate for an existing role, and no way to move users between roles from this screen.

NOTHING IN THIS MODULE PUSHES CHANGE EVENTS ANYWHERE. Consistent with the established ground truth that app/Events, app/Listeners and app/Observers do not exist, a department rename/delete, a job-role reassignment (tbluser.allocated_standards) or a status change is a bare UPDATE. Competency gap recalculation, LMS restrict_departments/restrict_roles enrolment rules, Talent succession pools and Task assignment scopes all cache or denormalise these keys and none of them are notified. Every downstream consumer is eventually-wrong until it re-queries.
